an10.89:1.1: [sāvatthi] atha kho kokāliko bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho kokāliko bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an10.89:1.2: “pāpicchā bhante sāriputta moggallānā, pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gatā”ti.
an10.89:1.3: mā hevaṃ kokālika, mā hevaṃ kokālika,
an10.89:2.1: dutiyampi kho kokāliko bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an10.89:2.2: “kiñcāpi me bhante bhagavā saddhāyiko paccayiko, atha kho pāpicchāva sāriputtamoggallānā pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gatā”ti.
an10.89:2.3: mā hevaṃ kokālika mā hevaṃ kokālika,
an10.89:3.1: tatiyampi kho kokāliko bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an10.89:3.2: “kiñcāpi me bhante bhagavā saddhāyiko paccayiko, atha kho pāpicchāva sāriputtamoggallānā pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gatā”ti.
an10.89:3.3: mā hevaṃ kokālika, mā hevaṃ kokālika,
an10.89:4.1: atha kho kokāliko bhikkhu uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
an10.89:4.2: acirapakkantasseva kokālikassa bhikkhuno sāsapamattāhi piḷakāhi sabbo kāyo phuṭo ahosi.
an10.89:4.3: sāsapamattiyo hutvā muggamattiyo ahesuṃ. muggamattiyo hutvā kalāyamattiyo ahesuṃ. kalāyamattiyo hutvā kolaṭṭhimattiyo ahesuṃ. kolaṭṭhimattiyo hutvā kolamattiyo ahesuṃ, kolamattiyo hutvā āmalakamattiyo ahesuṃ. āmalakamattiyo hutvā beluvasalāṭukamattiyo ahesuṃ. beluvasalāṭukamattiyo hutvā billamattiyo ahesuṃ. billamattiyo hutvā pabhijjiṃsu. pubbañca lohitañca pagghariṃsu.
an10.89:5.1: atha kho tudu pacceka brahmā yena kokāliko bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā vehāse ṭhatvā kokālikaṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca:
an10.89:5.6: nanu tvaṃ āvuso bhagavatā anāgāmī vyākato, atha kiṃ carahi idhāgato?
an10.89:6.1: atha kho tudu paccekabrahmā kokālikaṃ bhikkhuṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi:
an10.89:11.1: atha kho kokāliko bhikkhu teneva ābādhena kālamakāsi,
an10.89:11.2: kālakato ca kokāliko bhikkhu padumanirayaṃ upapajji sāriputtamoggallānesu cittaṃ āghātetvā.
an10.89:12.1: atha kho brahmā sahampati abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi, ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho brahmā sahampati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an10.89:12.3: kālakato ca bhante kokāliko bhikkhu padumanirayaṃ uppanno sāriputtamoggallānesu cittaṃ āghātetvā”ti.
an10.89:12.5: idaṃ vatvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
an10.89:13.1: atha kho bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhu āmantesi.
an10.89:13.2: imaṃ bhikkhave rattiṃ brahmā sahampati abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho bhikkhave brahmā sahampati maṃ etadavoca:
an10.89:13.4: kālakato ca bhante kokāliko bhikkhu padumanirayaṃ upapanno, sāriputtamuggallānesu cittaṃ āghātetvā”ti.
an10.89:13.6: idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyīti. dīghaṃ
an10.89:14.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an10.89:14.3: dīghaṃ kho bhikkhu padume niraye āyuppamāṇaṃ,
an10.89:14.5: “ettakāni vassānī”ti vā “ettakāni vassasatānī”ti vā “ettakāni vassasahassānī”ti vā “ettakāni vassa satasahassānī”ti vāti.
an10.89:15.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsatikhāriko kosalako tilavāho, tato puriso vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena ekamekaṃ tilaṃ uddhareyya,
an10.89:15.4: khippataraṃ kho so bhikkhu vīsatikhāriko kosalako tilavāho iminā upakkamena parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya, natveva eko abbudo nirayo.
an10.89:15.5: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati abbudā nirayā evameko nirabbudo nirayo.
an10.89:15.6: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati nirabbudā nirayā evameko ababo nirayo,
an10.89:15.7: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsatiababā nirayā evameko ahaho nirayo. seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati ahahā nirayā evameko aṭaṭo nirayo.
an10.89:15.8: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati aṭaṭā nirayā evameko
an10.89:15.10: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati kumudā nirayā evameko sogandhiko nirayo.
an10.89:15.11: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati sogandhikā nirayā evameko uppalako nirayo.
an10.89:15.12: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati uppalakā nirayā eva mevako puṇḍarīko nirayo.
an10.89:15.13: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati puṇḍarikā nirayā evameko padumo nirayo.
an10.89:15.14: padumaṃ kho pana bhikkhu nirayaṃ kokāliko bhikkhu upapanno sāriputtamoggallānesu cittaṃ āghātetvāti.
an10.89:15.16: idaṃ vatvā sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā.
